headline.family_guess: condensed serif/slab (Tiempos/Canela-Deck style) + bold sans mix
headline.case: upper for emphasis words, sentence-case otherwise

caption.size_rel: small, dense paragraph blocks for UI-mock screenshots

layout.safe_zones: full-bleed vertical 1080x1920, no persistent chrome/UI bar, text centered or left-aligned with generous margin
layout.caption_pos: no burned spoken-word captions; text is design copy placed mid-frame, not bottom-third karaoke captions

motion.cut_rate_per_10s: ~5-7 cuts/10s (roughly 1 new frame/sec of contact sheet = fast beat changes)
transitions: radiating starburst background pulse on intro

themeable: icon glyph swapped per app being demoed
